messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT Pager alert: tenant=marinerai (dedicated-us-east-2) severity=sev2 — tail latency spike +3x, error rate +2% vs baseline. Paging @elena @sam @jia

elena: on it. seeing spike on scheduler shards 4-6, sustained queue depth up ~4x.

sam: I can patch scheduler knobs. curious if this is batching related — client traffic pattern changed? any rollout from customer?

elena: marinerai reported a sudden increase in short-chat concurrent requests ~2m ago. pattern: many small messages, high token churn -> big KV cache churn + many tiny batches. max_batch_tokens currently 512 per-tenant.

jia: quick ask: can we try reducing `max_batch_tokens` to reduce head-of-line blocking? suggest 192-256 range. also consider turning on bespoke_shaper for that tenant.

mike: agree. smaller max batch reduces tail but may increase token-cost slightly. we should canary on one shard.

elena: doing canary: target shard 5. command: 
```
rcctl tenant update marinerai --pool dedicated-us-east-2 --set scheduler.knobs.max_batch_tokens=256 --set scheduler.knobs.bespoke_shaper=true --shard 5 --no-wait
```

sam: pushed change to shard 5. monitoring.

ops-bot: Deploy started: change=marinerai-bespoke-batching-2026-03-17 author=sam link=https://console.redwood/deploys/xyz

incident-bot: metric alert suppressed for marinerai (shard 5) — tail latency reduced ~45% on canary within 60s.

elena: canary looks good. tail p99 dropped from 1.2s -> 0.6s on shard 5. queue depth normalized.

jia: plan: roll remaining affected shards 4 and 6 with 30s stagger, monitor error-rate and token throughput. if errors spike, rollback.

mike: also enabling tenant-level rate cap for short-term relief: 
```
rcctl tenant update marinerai --set ingress.rate_limit.qps=1200 --shard 4,6
```

sam: rolling shards 4 and 6 now.

ops-bot: Rollout progress: shard4=done, shard6=done. Link: https://console.redwood/tenants/marinerai/rollouts/abc

incident-bot: post-change metrics: overall tail p99 down ~40% cluster-wide for tenant, errors back to baseline. Customer impact: degraded for ~7 minutes, now mitigated.

elena: leaving bespoke_shaper enabled and `max_batch_tokens=256` for 6h; will run cost/latency eval.

jia: creating follow-up ticket and perf eval: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 — includes prompt-set regressions, token-cost delta, rollback criteria.

mike: handoff: I'm off in 30m. handing to @jia for next 8h to monitor. please page if regression >15% in tail p99 or error rate >1% sustained.

jia: ACK. capturing runbook steps in ticket. will schedule a canary rollback if we see cost spike >5% or quality regressions flagged by evals.

elena: thanks team. closing incident channel in 10m unless new alerts. :thumbsup:
